title: Hailey Bieber & Justin Bieber Are Collaborating on a Line of Rhode Skincare Including New & Fan-Fave Products
summary: The line includes eye patches, a banana-scented peptide lip treatment and new pimple patches.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Hailey Bieber is finally tapping her husband, Justin Bieber, for a collaboration for her beauty and skincare brand, Rhode .

The collaborative line is comprised of three skincare products: the Spotwear pimple patches for $16 , Peptide Eye Patches for $25 and the famed Peptide Lip Treatment, this time in Caramelized Banana for $20 . The line seems to pull visual inspo from Justin’s clothing line, Drew House , with the usage of funky colors and inventive shapes. All of these products are available to shop now on Rhode’s website .

Spotwear Pimple Patches

$16

Buy Now at rhode

These pimple patches are anything but boring. Rhode dropped a bunch of unique and colorful styles that may help reduce the size of blemishes, treating acne by absorbing oil from active breakouts.

Peptide Eye Patches

$25

These are peptide-infused eye patches in yellow and brown with that unique Rhode logo throughout. These patches are said to create a cooling sensation, depuffing and brightening your area under the eyes while reducing the look of fine lines and dark spots.

Let’s start by unpacking the Spotwear pimple patches, an ingenious addition given that pimple patches have become the hottest new accessory within the past few years. Shoppers will have the option to choose between five shapes of pimple patches, including mushrooms, flowers and Rhode-themed jelly beans. If you’re unsure what pimple patches are, they are meant to help reduce the size of blemishes, treating your acne by absorbing oil from those pesky active breakouts. You’ll get 36 patches per pouch.

The Peptide Eye Patches are infused with, as the name suggests, peptides. In short, peptides are key for building up your skin’s collagen, elastin and keratin, all proteins. Peptides are found in a ton of popular Rhode products. Peptides are said to promote firmer, smoother and more elastic skin. These patches are meant to create a cooling sensation that depuffs, while the peptides are meant to brighten your undereyes while reducing the look of fine lines and darkness. Each box comes with six patches. To boost that depuffing sensation, we love to stick our patches into the fridge, keeping them extra cold before use.

Peptide Lip Treatment in Caramelized Banana

$20

This is a limited-edition hydrating lip balm/treatment in collaboration with Justin Bieber.

Finally, the ever-popular peptide lip treatment, which has become a signature product for Rhode. Justin’s contribution is a Caramelized Banana scent. This lip treatment is said to hydrate and replenish lips while leaving a glossy, high-shine finish that isn’t sticky or uncomfortable. The peptides in this formula are likely meant to plump, firm and hydrate the lips. The full collection is limited-edition, so once each product is gone, it’ll be gone for good.
